papers.title: WorldInteract: Controllable Streaming Video Generation for Multi-Material Interactions
papers.abstract: Video world models aim to create interactive physical worlds that capture how diverse materials move and interact. Yet material-dependent dynamics remain underexplored in controllable video generation, limiting reliable control in scenes with different materials. We present WorldInteract, a streaming video generation framework that decomposes cross-material interaction into material-dependent behavior generation and contact response computation. External pushes and contact impulses are expressed through a shared velocity-increment interface, allowing material behaviors learned from interaction-free videos to be reused in interacting scenes. A physics controller predicts contacts and computes velocity increments from estimated masses and restitution coefficients, while a causal generator executes these increments using learned material behaviors. This separation enables cross-material interaction without supervised contact videos spanning diverse material pairings and contact configurations. We train the generator on 30k simulated interaction-free videos spanning 22 material classes and introduce Material-Aware RL, using verifiable physical rewards to refine material behavior and control execution. WorldInteract substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods on Physics-IQ and delivers more reliable push control on real-world images.
papers.summary_cn: WorldInteract 面向多材料物理交互的流式视频生成，将材料本身在速度变化下的行为学习与物体接触时的动量交换计算分开处理。模型通过共享速度增量接口，把外部推动和物理控制器预测的接触冲量统一输入因果视频生成器；场景记忆、深度位置图和目标跟踪图用于维持长时间生成中的物体状态与身份。训练分为无交互材料行为学习、因果状态传播和材料感知强化学习三阶段，并通过四步 DMD 蒸馏实现单张 H100 上约8 fps 的交互式流式生成。实验表明，该方法在 Physics-IQ 和真实图像推动控制上均优于多个基线，并能体现推动强度、方向、材料和形状带来的行为差异。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 提出将材料相关行为生成与接触响应计算解耦的跨材料交互框架，通过共享速度增量接口在推理时组合二者。2. 提出材料感知强化学习，使用位移准确性、速度增量一致性、成对行为关系和事件时序等可验证物理奖励，改进材料行为及接触控制执行。3. 构建涵盖22类材料的3万个模拟无交互视频数据集，使模型能够学习单材料行为而无需穷举材料配对和接触配置。4. 引入场景记忆、物体跟踪与位置图支持因果流式生成，并通过因果模型蒸馏实现约8 fps 的交互式生成。
papers.relevance_cn: 该工作与研究重点高度相关：它直接研究视频扩散世界模型、动作条件控制、因果与流式生成以及闭环物理模拟。用户推动被编码为速度增量，接触响应由物理控制器根据生成视频中的跟踪、深度和物体属性预测，再反馈给下一视频块，形成控制器与生成器交替执行的闭环过程。方法采用因果注意力、键值缓存、场景状态记忆和四步 DMD 蒸馏，涉及长视频一致性、实时生成、缓存复用和加速。其重点不是通用轨迹跟随，而是让同一控制接口适应刚体、弹性体、流体和沙等材料的不同动力学。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文明确指出，当前物理控制器使用近似几何和无摩擦的中心碰撞模型，尚未覆盖更丰富的接触模型。物体质量和恢复系数依赖视觉语言模型从图像估计，存在估计误差。训练数据主要是模拟的无物体间接触视频，真实接触场景通过控制器生成的轨迹和强化学习间接学习。真实图像评测使用200张图像，语义遵循性和物理常识部分依赖视觉语言模型评分，缺少真实世界接触视频的全面定量真值。论文未明确说明在更长时间跨度、更复杂遮挡、多物体密集接触或更高分辨率下的性能。
papers.abstract_cn: 视频世界模型旨在创建能够捕捉多种材料运动与相互作用的可交互物理世界。然而，材料相关动力学在可控视频生成中仍未得到充分研究，这限制了模型在不同材料场景中的可靠控制。我们提出 WorldInteract，一种流式视频生成框架，将跨材料交互分解为材料相关行为生成和接触响应计算。外部推动和接触冲量通过共享的速度增量接口表示，使得从无交互视频中学习的材料行为能够复用于交互场景。物理控制器根据估计的质量和恢复系数预测接触并计算速度增量，而因果生成器利用学习到的材料行为执行这些增量。这种分离使模型无需覆盖多种材料组合和接触配置的监督接触视频，即可实现跨材料交互。我们在涵盖22类材料的3万个模拟无交互视频上训练生成器，并提出材料感知强化学习，利用可验证的物理奖励来改进材料行为和控制执行。WorldInteract 在 Physics-IQ 上显著优于现有先进方法，并在真实世界图像上实现了更可靠的推动控制。

papers.title: ShowNow: Fine-Grained Speculative Streaming for Responsive World Models
papers.abstract: Interactive world models must generate video continuously while responding promptly to user actions. Real-time throughput alone leaves input latency unresolved: coarse generation blocks delay action updates, and generation after input adds work to the response path. We introduce ShowNow, a fine-grained speculative streaming framework that uses computation available during playback to prepare action-conditioned futures before input arrives. Single-latent commitment enables frequent decisions, while configurable preparation covers one to eight actions. We construct a matched multi-future dataset to train alternative continuations from a common state; shared-history tree execution and fused commitment make their preparation efficient. On a single H100, our 5B model sustains 480p generation at 16 fps with eight prepared futures. In ViZDoom, the complete ShowNow deployment reduces median input-to-display latency from 620 to 208 ms relative to the native-block SolarWM-FT deployment. Matched-policy experiments reduce restart empty ticks from 1.56% to 0.09% (94%) and improve on-time responses to action changes. These results establish complementary roles for fine-grained commitment and advance preparation, with measured trade-offs in visual fidelity and long-horizon consistency. ShowNow turns playback-time computation into responsive visual interaction. Project: https://github.com/showlab/ShowNow.
papers.comment: 23 pages, including appendix. Video examples provided as ancillary files
papers.summary_cn: 论文提出 ShowNow，用于降低交互式世界模型的视频输入响应延迟。系统以单潜变量进行更频繁的提交，并在播放期间从同一历史状态并行准备多个动作条件化未来；用户输入到达后直接选择匹配分支，再将其作为下一轮生成的共同历史。作者构建了匹配的八动作多未来 ViZDoom 数据集，并结合因果蒸馏、自强制训练、分支树注意力、共享历史缓存和融合提交实现实时推理。在单张 H100 上，5B 模型可在 480p、16 fps 下准备八个未来；完整部署将中位输入到显示延迟从 620 ms 降至 208 ms，并显著减少重启空帧。实验还显示，提前准备可提高临近显示截止时间时的按时响应和播放连续性，但细粒度自回归及部署优化会带来视觉质量和长时一致性下降。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 提出 ShowNow 细粒度推测式流式框架，将播放期间的计算用于提前准备动作条件化未来，并统一单未来和多未来准备，在计算开销与响应速度之间提供可配置权衡。 2. 构建并发布从相同世界状态分叉的匹配多未来数据集，包含八种动作、持续动作和动作切换，用于训练不同动作下的一致历史与差异化后续。 3. 提出共享历史的分支树注意力、历史缓存、分区注意力和融合提交机制，避免重复计算并降低多分支推理的时间和显存开销。 4. 结合教师适配、AnyFlow 因果蒸馏和 Self-Forcing，训练三步去噪、单潜变量更新的实时生成模型。 5. 在单张 H100 上实现 5B 模型以 480p、16 fps 准备八个未来，并通过实验证明其在输入到显示延迟、空帧比例、截止时间内响应和高分辨率 33B 扩展方面的效果。
papers.relevance_cn: 论文与研究重点高度相关。它直接研究动作条件化视觉世界模型的闭环交互，将用户动作作为条件，并通过 prepare–select–commit 循环持续生成和更新视频。其单潜变量提交、因果自回归生成和播放期间提前推测未来，分别对应细粒度决策、流式/长视频生成和降低输入响应延迟。共享历史树执行、滚动缓存、分区注意力与融合提交直接涉及稀疏或复用历史计算、缓存复用和实时推理优化。AnyFlow 蒸馏与三步采样则对应生成加速和蒸馏。实验还量化了 16 fps 实时生成、32 fps 加速播放、动作切换响应以及输入到显示延迟，体现了面向闭环模拟的实际交互性能。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文报告了若干局限和权衡：ShowNow 的细粒度自回归生成相较于基线具有更低的短期动作切换延迟，但其整体动作准确率和稳定后的准确率并不全面占优，视觉指标也出现下降；长时一刻钟级滚动中，部署路径和更长的自回归历史会降低生成质量与一致性。多未来准备需要显著的 GPU 计算资源，八未来配置占用约 80% GPU 忙碌时间，并依赖单张 H100 才能达到报告的实时点。覆盖动作之外的输入仍需重新生成，无法直接享受预准备分支的收益。实验主要基于 ViZDoom 和有限的动作集合，跨环境、跨任务及真实机器人闭环控制的泛化能力未被充分验证。33B 结果使用八路序列并行、B300 GPU 和额外 GPU 解码的建模设置，不等同于单 GPU 实时部署。论文未明确说明更复杂动作空间、长期用户策略变化和极端负载下的性能上限。
papers.abstract_cn: 交互式世界模型必须在持续生成视频的同时，及时响应用户操作。仅有实时吞吐率并不能解决输入延迟：粗粒度生成会延迟动作更新，而在输入到达后才开始生成又会增加响应路径上的工作量。我们提出 ShowNow，一种细粒度推测式流式框架，利用播放期间可用的计算资源，在输入到达前准备动作条件化的未来。单潜变量提交支持高频决策，可配置的准备机制覆盖一到八个动作。我们构建了匹配的多未来数据集，用于从共同状态训练不同的后续轨迹；共享历史的树执行和融合提交机制提高了准备效率。在单张 H100 上，我们的 5B 模型在准备八个未来的情况下，能够以 16 fps 持续生成 480p 视频。在 ViZDoom 中，与原生阻塞式 SolarWM-FT 部署相比，完整的 ShowNow 部署将输入到显示的中位延迟从 620 毫秒降低至 208 毫秒。匹配策略实验将重启空帧比例从 1.56% 降低至 0.09%（降低 94%），并改善了对动作变化的按时响应。这些结果表明，细粒度提交与提前准备具有互补作用，同时也存在已测量的视觉保真度和长时一致性权衡。ShowNow 将播放期间的计算转化为响应迅速的视觉交互。

papers.title: LiveVAE: Causal Window Attention Makes Efficient Streaming Video VAE
papers.abstract: While video diffusion models have grown faster and increasingly streamable, the video VAE remains a primary latency bottleneck across interactive generation and editing pipelines. Existing VAEs and their acceleration methods rely mainly on heavy convolutions or full frame attention, and most focus only on decoding, leaving encoding costly for streaming conditional generation and editing. This raises a natural question: Do video VAE encoding and decoding actually require such global spatiotemporal modeling? By analyzing the effective receptive fields of pretrained video VAEs, we find that both encoding and decoding a patch rely almost entirely on its spatial and temporal neighbors. To exploit this strong locality, we introduce LiveVAE, a streaming encoder and decoder built on causal window attention, which cuts per frame compute while keeping the temporal KV cache bounded for streaming. Decoupled encoder/decoder distillation followed by joint finetuning preserves the pretrained latent space, making LiveVAE a drop-in replacement for the original VAE. On MiniMax-H3, LiveVAE achieves 5.2-6.2x faster encoding and 3.0-3.3x faster decoding than the official VAE with higher PSNR. Paired with our dedicated inference infrastructure, LiveVAE pushes the speedup to 13.4x with almost no quality loss. Code and models will be released.
papers.summary_cn: 论文针对实时视频生成、流式编辑和参考视频生成中的 VAE 延迟瓶颈，提出 LiveVAE。作者通过有效感受野和扰动实验发现，预训练视频 VAE 的编码与解码主要依赖局部空间邻域和短时因果邻域，因此使用固定大小的因果窗口注意力替代全局时空建模。LiveVAE 在 latent 网格上采用流式 Transformer 编码器和解码器，并通过滚动 KV 缓存实现与视频长度无关的有界缓存。为保持已有扩散 Transformer 的潜空间兼容性，论文采用编码器蒸馏、解码器蒸馏和联合微调三阶段训练，并结合注意力算子融合、区域编译和带量化感知训练的 FP8 FFN。基于 MiniMax-H3 和 Wan2.2 的实验表明，该方法在编码、解码速度、显存占用和高分辨率外推方面具有优势；在生成任务中总体质量接近官方 VAE，但在部分人类保真度、物理一致性和感知细节上仍存在差距。
papers.contribution_cn:
1. 通过有效感受野分析和扰动实验，证明视频 VAE 的编码与解码主要依赖局部空间邻域及当前和近期时间步，而不需要完整的全局时空建模。
2. 提出基于因果窗口注意力的 LiveVAE 流式编码器和解码器，使计算复杂度随 token 数量线性增长，并将时间 KV 缓存限制在固定数量的 latent 帧内。
3. 提出三阶段渐进式蒸馏框架，包括独立的编码器蒸馏、解码器蒸馏和端到端联合微调，以保留预训练 VAE 的 latent 空间并实现即插即用替换。
4. 设计专用推理优化方案，包括注意力算子融合、区域级编译和带 QAT 的 FP8 前馈层，在较小质量损失下进一步降低端到端延迟。
5. 在 MiniMax-H3 和 Wan2.2 上验证了方法的速度、重建质量、显存效率、高分辨率外推和下游视频生成兼容性。
papers.relevance_cn: 与研究重点高度相关。LiveVAE 直接服务于视频扩散和实时视频生成，将视频 VAE 从生成流程中的主要延迟瓶颈转化为可流式处理的组件。其因果窗口注意力和滚动 KV 缓存与因果、流式、长视频生成的设计目标一致：每次处理一个视频块，缓存大小不随视频时长增长。方法同时加速编码和解码，因此适用于需要在线压缩输入帧或参考视频的流式编辑、条件生成和参考视频生成，而不只是生成端解码。局部窗口注意力降低了高分辨率下的空间注意力开销，FP8、算子融合和编译优化则进一步对应实时推理和系统级加速。论文不直接研究动作条件视觉世界模型或闭环模拟，但其低延迟、因果视频编码解码组件可作为此类交互式世界模型的实时视觉输入输出模块。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文明确指出，LiveVAE 仍存在感知质量差距，细节可能变得模糊，尤其是在密集纹理、小文字、小人脸和快速运动等场景；在 MiniMax-H3 上，VBench-2.0 的 Human Fidelity 和 Physics 指标低于官方解码器。作者认为，部分差距源于其继承的卷积式 VAE 潜空间。Wan2.2 和较长视频实验中，LiveVAE 在部分设置下的 PSNR 低于官方 VAE，且 LPIPS 仍可能更高。FP8 优化在低分辨率下收益有限，甚至可能因固定开销而降低速度，并增加显存占用，因此主要建议用于 1080p 及以上分辨率。实验主要基于 MiniMax-H3 和 Wan2.2、内部训练数据及 NVIDIA H100，外部数据集和硬件上的泛化情况论文未明确说明。论文也未直接评估动作条件视觉世界模型或闭环模拟任务。
papers.abstract_cn: 尽管视频扩散模型变得更快速且越来越具备流式处理能力，视频 VAE 仍是交互式生成和编辑流程中的主要延迟瓶颈。现有 VAE 及其加速方法主要依赖计算量较大的卷积或全帧注意力，并且大多只关注解码，导致流式条件生成和编辑中的编码成本依然很高。这引出了一个自然问题：视频 VAE 的编码和解码是否真的需要全局时空建模？通过分析预训练视频 VAE 的有效感受野，我们发现，编码和解码一个局部块时，几乎完全依赖其空间和时间邻域。为利用这一强局部性，我们提出 LiveVAE：一种基于因果窗口注意力的流式编码器和解码器，在降低每帧计算量的同时，使流式处理中的时间 KV 缓存保持有界。通过解耦的编码器/解码器蒸馏以及后续联合微调，LiveVAE 保留了预训练潜空间，因此可以直接替换原始 VAE。在 MiniMax-H3 上，与官方 VAE 相比，LiveVAE 的编码速度提升 5.2–6.2 倍，解码速度提升 3.0–3.3 倍，同时获得更高的 PSNR。结合专用推理基础设施后，LiveVAE 可将加速提升至 13.4 倍，并且几乎没有质量损失。代码和模型将会发布。

papers.title: Agentic LongLive: Asynchronous Agentic Memory for Long Video Generation
papers.abstract: Real-time autoregressive video generators stream minutes of video and accept new prompts on the fly, but struggle to keep people, objects, and places consistent over a long interactive story. Agent systems provide such memory for offline multi-shot generation, yet they read the whole script in advance, plan each shot before generating it, and regenerate failed shots, which a live stream does not allow. We present Agentic LongLive, an asynchronous agentic memory for long video generation. A memory agent on separate GPUs reads only the prompts revealed so far, never the generated video, and keeps a text state and evolving images for every person, object, and scene. From this entity memory it composes a global image and a per-shot memory image, which an auxiliary GPU prefills into the generator's attention sink before the next shot starts, and writes entity cards for the prompts that name them, so the video never waits for memory and video errors are not written back. A small language model, trained with reinforcement learning and an image reward calibrated using downstream video outcomes, decides what to remember before the next prompt is known. On LongStory-Online, a new benchmark of 25 stories (857 shots) revealed one shot at a time, Agentic LongLive improves persistent-state accuracy of LongLive-2.0, its base generator, by 26.3 points, protagonist identity by 44.9, and revisited-place consistency by 40.4, at about 1% extra generation time on H100. The full system streams faster than real time on one 8xB200 node with the generator in BF16 (34.3 FPS), keeps image quality stable over 14-minute stories, and improves identity on two MiniMax-H3 generators, one of which, LongLive-H3, also runs in real time with it. To our knowledge, it is the first real-time video generator with text and image memory kept by an LLM agent.
papers.summary_cn: Real-time autoregressive video generators stream minutes of video and accept new prompts on the fly, but struggle to keep people, objects, and places consistent over a long interactive story.
papers.contribution_cn: We present Agentic LongLive, an asynchronous agentic memory for long video generation.
papers.relevance_cn: 匹配研究线：streaming video, efficient generation；关键词：interactive, autoregressive, long video, real-time, video generation
papers.limitations_cn: 规则模式无法可靠判断实验质量与论文局限。

papers.title: Understanding Diffusion Acceleration: Methods, Trade-Offs, and Open Questions
papers.abstract: Diffusion and flow-based generative models support high-quality image, audio, and video synthesis. Sampling can require dozens to hundreds of denoiser evaluations, with each pass becoming more expensive as resolution, video length, or model size increases. This cost affects latency and energy use in interactive and edge applications. We examine four approaches to accelerating inference: distillation, consistency training, sampling methods, and denoiser design. We express training objectives, transition maps, and numerical updates in a common notation to compare changes to the learning target, the sampling trajectory, and the work performed within each denoiser pass. Published image and video benchmarks illustrate the quality--cost trade-offs of one- and few-step generation, the interaction between solvers and timestep schedules, the effect of feature caching, and the difference between first-frame latency and sustained streaming throughput. We close with open problems in visual-native architectures and post-compression distillation, solver-aware few-step training, and semantic trajectory alignment with factorized distribution matching.
papers.summary_cn: Diffusion and flow-based generative models support high-quality image, audio, and video synthesis.
papers.contribution_cn: 请快速查看方法图和主要实验表确认具体贡献。
papers.relevance_cn: 匹配研究线：efficient generation, streaming video；关键词：interactive, streaming, acceleration, few-step, distillation, video synthesis
papers.limitations_cn: 规则模式无法可靠判断实验质量与论文局限。

papers.title: VivaWorld: Long-Horizon Video World Model With Compositional 3D Priors
papers.abstract: Long-horizon video generation is key to interactive world modeling, physical intelligence, and spatial reasoning, yet maintaining geometric consistency and accurate camera control remains challenging without 3D grounding. We introduce \textbf{VivaWorld}, a framework for generating geometry- and view-consistent long videos from an image. We first construct a compositional hybrid 3D representation that combines reconstructed point clouds, which preserve observed scene geometry and appearance, with generated textured meshes, which provide complete object geometry across $360^\circ$ novel views. We also introduce a connected-region filter removing inconsistent floating components for robust cross-view reconstruction and propose a hybrid camera embedding that combines global and object-anchored Plücker rays to capture both scene-level camera motion and camera-object relationships, and inject it together with the visual guidance into a video generation model via a control adapter. Extensive experiments show VivaWorld achieves state-of-the-art visual quality and camera control, while supporting controllable novel-view synthesis, long-horizon scene exploration, and physical AI. Project page is available at: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/sil/projects/vivaworld/

papers.title: Residual Guidance for Real-Time Interactive Video Generation
papers.abstract: Real-time interactive video generation allows users to change the prompt during generation to steer the evolving video. However, existing streaming models, which generate videos chunk by chunk, often keep following the previous prompt after a switch. We trace this failure to context inertia, where the previous chunk acts as a strong prior that suppresses the new prompt. Furthermore, we find that this inertia persists even when the cache retains only the previous chunk, yet discarding the context breaks visual continuity, which limits approaches that edit the cache. Rather than editing the cache, we propose Residual Guidance (RG), a simple, training-free method that counteracts context inertia with a correction measured outside the cache. Specifically, RG denoises the re-noised previous chunk once under the new prompt without the cache and adds the resulting residual to the early denoising steps of the next chunk, where its content is largely decided and the new prompt is most suppressed. Across settings ranging from a single switch to long multi-switch generation, RG substantially improves prompt switching capability on existing streaming models, including those with dedicated switching mechanisms, while largely retaining visual quality. As it requires no training or per-model tuning and adds only one forward pass per chunk, RG can be easily integrated into existing real-time video generation pipelines.

papers.title: DiffGR00T: Execution-Aware Differentiable Training for Humanoid Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong results in arm-centric manipulation, yet humanoid whole-body control (WBC) requires dynamic balance and tightly coupled full-body coordination. Existing hierarchical humanoid VLAs typically decouple motion generation from physical execution, leaving tracking and balance errors unable to directly optimize the VLA generator. We propose DiffGR00T, an end-to-end differentiable training framework that couples GR00T N1.7 with SONIC, a pretrained whole-body behavior foundation model. To enable execution-aware differentiable training, we replace the non-differentiable simulator with a learned, action-conditioned world model, allowing multi-step body-execution losses to backpropagate through the frozen whole-body controller and the flow-matching sampler directly into the VLA action head. On four HumanoidArena simulation tasks, DiffGR00T improves average task success by 12.5 percentage points over the supervised base VLA (59.2% to 71.7%), demonstrating that execution-aware gradients effectively align high-level motion generation with closed-loop whole-body dynamics.

papers.title: AnyCam: Anything Can Represent Camera for Video Generation
papers.abstract: Camera-controlled video generation re-renders a video along a target camera trajectory, yet moving the camera around an object, the most natural way to change the viewpoint of an object-centric scene, remains difficult. Existing methods condition either on camera parameters, which are scale-ambiguous in monocular video, or on explicit geometry such as warped point clouds or depth, which breaks down under large viewpoint changes. We present AnyCam, a method that represents the camera with an anchor object in the scene: we reconstruct it in 3D and render it along the target trajectory, a camera signal that is scale-aware, view-complete and easy to specify relative to the object. A video diffusion model transfers the content and dynamics of the source video to the new viewpoint. Its H-Concat layout aligns source and target frames in time, so the model can be distilled into AnyCam-AR, a streaming few-step generator for on-the-fly camera control. Both models are trained on paired videos with pixel-aligned anchor renderings from multi-camera videos and static-scene captures. Experiments on diverse datasets and trajectories show that AnyCam performs favorably against camera-controlled video generation and 3D reconstruction methods in camera control and visual quality.

papers.title: DexWAC: A Unified World-Actor-Critic Model for Dexterous Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robot demonstrations provide more than actions to imitate: they reveal how actions change the world and how those changes contribute to task success. Recent world-action models (WAMs) extend vision-language-action (VLA) models with the first signal by jointly predicting actions and future observations, yet this predictive ability serves only as an auxiliary loss for policy learning. Meanwhile, most policy improvement methods learn dynamics and values in separate models, increasing training overhead and limiting representation sharing between these complementary objectives. We introduce DexWAC, a unified world-actor-critic model that jointly learns an actor, an action-conditioned world model, and a bootstrapped critic in a single robot pretraining stage. Our key insight is that visual prediction encourages control-relevant features, while value supervision promotes task-relevant representations; together, they shape a representation suited to policy learning. Built on an image-editing backbone, DexWAC predicts, for each action chunk, the visual latent and proprioception at its endpoint together with its reward and continuation, so the world model alone efficiently yields complete imagined transitions without generating intermediate video frames. After adapting the world model and critic on real rollouts, we improve the pretrained actor through either PPO on imagined rollouts or critic-guided best-of-$N$ selection. DexWAC surpasses the large-scale pretrained VLA and WAM baselines in simulation and achieves 75% average success on two real-world tasks, compared with 45% for $π_{0.5}$. Its world model is more accurate and faster than video-based baselines, and ablations confirm that learning dynamics and value together improves the policy.
